shadowpriest:VampiricTouch.NAME: Vampiric Touch
shadowpriest:VampiricTouch.DESCRIPTION: Apply !shadowpriest:Turns! shadowpriest:Touch. NL If played, return to your hand at turn end.

shadowpriest:ShadowWordPain.NAME: Shadow Word: Pain
shadowpriest:ShadowWordPain.DESCRIPTION: Apply !shadowpriest:Turns! shadowpriest:Pain. NL If played, return to your hand at turn end.

shadowpriest:EnterVoidform.NAME: Enter Voidform
shadowpriest:EnterVoidform.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Enter shadowpriest:Voidform. NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:Bulwark.NAME: Bulwark
shadowpriest:Bulwark.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL Block is not removed at the start of your next turn.

shadowpriest:Fade.NAME: Fade
shadowpriest:Fade.DESCRIPTION: Until your next turn, whenever you would lose HP, lose !M! less.

shadowpriest:MindFlay.NAME: Mind Flay
shadowpriest:MindFlay.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage !M! times. NL After each hit, extend existing Touch and Pain by 1.

shadowpriest:ShadowWordDeath.NAME: Shadow Word: Death
shadowpriest:ShadowWordDeath.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL If the enemy is above !M!% HP before the hit, lose 3 HP if it loses HP.
shadowpriest:ShadowWordDeath.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage twice. NL Each hit: if the enemy is above !M!% HP before the hit, lose 3 HP if it loses HP.

shadowpriest:MindBlast.NAME: Mind Blast
shadowpriest:MindBlast.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Damage increases by !M! per unique DoT on the target.

shadowpriest:Dispersion.NAME: Dispersion
shadowpriest:Dispersion.DESCRIPTION: Gain 1 Intangible. NL End your turn. NL Exhaust.
shadowpriest:Dispersion.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Gain 1 Intangible. NL End your turn. NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:DesperatePrayer.NAME: Desperate Prayer
shadowpriest:DesperatePrayer.DESCRIPTION: Before your next turn, heal HP lost to the next enemy Attack after taking damage. NL Does not prevent lethal damage.

shadowpriest:Foresight.NAME: Foresight
shadowpriest:Foresight.DESCRIPTION: Choose a Power from your draw pile and put it into your hand.
shadowpriest:Foresight.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Choose a Power from your draw pile and play it for free.

shadowpriest:MindFlayInsanity.NAME: Mind Flay: Insanity
shadowpriest:MindFlayInsanity.DESCRIPTION: Extend all DoTs on the target by X turns (max 5). NL Deal !D! damage X times.
shadowpriest:MindFlayInsanity.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Extend all DoTs on the target by X+1 turns (max 5). NL Deal !D! damage X+1 times.

shadowpriest:MindSear.NAME: Mind Sear
shadowpriest:MindSear.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to ALL enemies X times.
shadowpriest:MindSear.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to ALL enemies X+1 times.

shadowpriest:PsychicLink.NAME: Psychic Link
shadowpriest:PsychicLink.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play an Attack, trigger shadowpriest:Touch damage on ALL afflicted enemies without reducing its duration.

shadowpriest:PowerWordFortitude.NAME: Power Word: Fortitude
shadowpriest:PowerWordFortitude.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Dexterity. NL This benefit does not stack. NL Unplayable if Fortitude already granted this much this combat.

shadowpriest:ReapingMadness.NAME: Reaping Madness
shadowpriest:ReapingMadness.DESCRIPTION: At the end of your turn, gain !M! Insanity.

shadowpriest:ShadowWordMadness.NAME: Shadow Word: Madness
shadowpriest:ShadowWordMadness.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Apply shadowpriest:Madness equal to HP removed.

shadowpriest:Halo.NAME: Halo
shadowpriest:Halo.DESCRIPTION: At the end of your turn, deal !M! damage to ALL enemies for 3 turns. NL Each cast creates a separate aura.

shadowpriest:TentacleSlam.NAME: Tentacle Slam
shadowpriest:TentacleSlam.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Apply !M! shadowpriest:Touch to the target and enemies between you and it.

shadowpriest:VoidBlast.NAME: Void Blast
shadowpriest:VoidBlast.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Add the target's DoT stacks to ALL other enemies. NL Touch and Pain cap at 5.

shadowpriest:MassDispel.NAME: Mass Dispel
shadowpriest:MassDispel.DESCRIPTION: Remove ALL enemies' Block, Artifact, and positive Strength.

shadowpriest:VampiricEmbrace.NAME: Vampiric Embrace
shadowpriest:VampiricEmbrace.DESCRIPTION: Whenever shadowpriest:Touch removes enemy HP, heal !M! HP.

shadowpriest:VoidBolt.NAME: Void Bolt
shadowpriest:VoidBolt.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Add !M! stack(s) to each existing DoT. NL Touch and Pain cap at 5.

shadowpriest:VoidVolley.NAME: Void Volley
shadowpriest:VoidVolley.DESCRIPTION: X times: deal !D! damage to a random enemy, then add !M! stack(s) to each existing DoT. NL Touch and Pain cap at 5.

shadowpriest:VoidTorrent.NAME: Void Torrent
shadowpriest:VoidTorrent.DESCRIPTION: Deal damage X times to an enemy. NL First hit: !D!. NL Each hit's base damage increases by !M!.

shadowpriest:SurrenderToMadness.NAME: Surrender to Madness
shadowpriest:SurrenderToMadness.DESCRIPTION: Enter shadowpriest:Voidform for the rest of combat. NL Take double damage from enemy Attacks. NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:Penance.NAME: Penance
shadowpriest:Penance.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage !M! times to an enemy, or heal yourself for 3 HP !M! times. NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:Atonement.NAME: Atonement
shadowpriest:Atonement.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Block per unique DoT on the target.

shadowpriest:PurifyDisease.NAME: Purify Disease
shadowpriest:PurifyDisease.DESCRIPTION: Remove Weak, Frail, and Vulnerable from yourself. NL Exhaust.
shadowpriest:PurifyDisease.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Remove Weak, Frail, and Vulnerable from yourself. NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:DispelMagic.NAME: Dispel Magic
shadowpriest:DispelMagic.DESCRIPTION: Remove ALL Block from the target. If any was removed, gain 1 Dexterity.
shadowpriest:DispelMagic.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Remove ALL Block and Artifact. Gain 1 Dexterity if Block was removed and 1 shadowpriest:Mastery if Artifact was removed.

shadowpriest:BodyAndSoul.NAME: Body and Soul
shadowpriest:BodyAndSoul.DESCRIPTION: Each enemy Attack hit has a !M!% chance to miss. NL Does not stack.

shadowpriest:InsidiousIre.NAME: Insidious Ire
shadowpriest:InsidiousIre.DESCRIPTION: At the start of your turn, apply 1 Vulnerable to each enemy with Touch, Pain, and Madness.

shadowpriest:PetrifyingScream.NAME: Petrifying Scream
shadowpriest:PetrifyingScream.DESCRIPTION: Stun the target for 1 turn. NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:ShadowCommittal.NAME: Shadow Committal
shadowpriest:ShadowCommittal.DESCRIPTION: In shadowpriest:Voidform, playing an Attack grants 1 Strength, a Skill grants 1 Dexterity, and a Power grants 1 shadowpriest:Mastery.

shadowpriest:FlashHeal.NAME: Flash Heal
shadowpriest:FlashHeal.DESCRIPTION: Heal !M! HP. NL Increase this card's cost by 1 this combat.

shadowpriest:VoidShield.NAME: Void Shield
shadowpriest:VoidShield.DESCRIPTION: Gain 2 Block per 10 Insanity. NL shadowpriest:Voidform counts as 100 Insanity.
shadowpriest:VoidShield.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Gain 20 Insanity. NL Gain 2 Block per 10 Insanity. NL shadowpriest:Voidform counts as 100 Insanity.

shadowpriest:Insight.NAME: Shadowy Insight
shadowpriest:Insight.DESCRIPTION: Draw 1 card per unique DoT on the target. NL One Shadowy Insight per turn. NL Exhaust.
shadowpriest:Insight.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Draw 1 card per unique DoT on the target. NL One Shadowy Insight per turn.

shadowpriest:PowerWordBarrier.NAME: Power Word: Barrier
shadowpriest:PowerWordBarrier.DESCRIPTION: Retain your hand this turn. NL Gain !B! Block per card in your hand. NL Dexterity applies per card.

shadowpriest:Piety.NAME: Piety
shadowpriest:Piety.DESCRIPTION: If your hand has no Attacks, draw 2 Attacks. If it has no Skills other than Piety, draw 2 Skills. NL Exhaust.
shadowpriest:Piety.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: If your hand has no Attacks, draw 2 Attacks. If it has no Skills other than Piety, draw 2 Skills.

shadowpriest:Serendipity.NAME: Serendipity
shadowpriest:Serendipity.DESCRIPTION: Choose: Discard all Skills to draw that many Attacks, or discard all Attacks to draw that many Skills. NL Exhaust.
shadowpriest:Serendipity.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Choose: Discard all Skills to draw that many Attacks, or discard all Attacks to draw that many Skills.

shadowpriest:SerendipityAttack.NAME: Seek Attacks
shadowpriest:SerendipityAttack.DESCRIPTION: Discard all Skills. NL Draw that many Attacks from your draw pile.

shadowpriest:SerendipitySkill.NAME: Seek Skills
shadowpriest:SerendipitySkill.DESCRIPTION: Discard all Attacks. NL Draw that many Skills from your draw pile.

shadowpriest:TitheEvasion.NAME: Tithe Evasion
shadowpriest:TitheEvasion.DESCRIPTION: Lose !M! less HP from Shadow Word: Death and Shadow Mend. NL Does not stack.

shadowpriest:Dragonwrath.NAME: Dragonwrath
shadowpriest:Dragonwrath.DESCRIPTION: Legendary. NL Equips at combat start. NL Attacks have a !M!% chance to repeat for free. NL Repeats cannot trigger this again.

shadowpriest:Xalatath.NAME: Xal'atath
shadowpriest:Xalatath.DESCRIPTION: Legendary. NL At combat start, randomly gain 2 Strength, shadowpriest:Mastery, or Dexterity !M! times.

shadowpriest:Valanyr.NAME: Val'anyr
shadowpriest:Valanyr.DESCRIPTION: Legendary. NL Start with !M! Block. Retain Block until it is depleted. NL Once per combat, lethal damage leaves you at 1 HP.

shadowpriest:MentalFortitude.NAME: Mental Fortitude
shadowpriest:MentalFortitude.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Dexterity and !M! shadowpriest:Mastery. NL Lose 2 Strength.

shadowpriest:MindSoothe.NAME: Mind Soothe
shadowpriest:MindSoothe.DESCRIPTION: This turn, the enemy deals 1 less Attack damage per unique DoT on it.
shadowpriest:MindSoothe.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: This turn, the enemy deals 1 less Attack damage per unique DoT on it, plus 1 more.

shadowpriest:DarkVoid.NAME: Dark Void
shadowpriest:DarkVoid.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to ALL enemies. NL Apply !M! shadowpriest:Pain to each that loses HP.

shadowpriest:PowerInfusion.NAME: Power Infusion
shadowpriest:PowerInfusion.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! shadowpriest:Haste this turn. NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:ShadowCrash.NAME: Shadow Crash
shadowpriest:ShadowCrash.DESCRIPTION: At the start of your next turn, apply !M! shadowpriest:Touch to ALL enemies.

shadowpriest:CrystallineReflection.NAME: Crystalline Reflection
shadowpriest:CrystallineReflection.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block X times. NL Gain X Thorns until your next turn.

shadowpriest:ProtectedChannel.NAME: Protected Channel
shadowpriest:ProtectedChannel.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play an X-cost card, gain !M! Block X times. NL Includes shadowpriest:Haste.

shadowpriest:Catharsis.NAME: Catharsis
shadowpriest:Catharsis.DESCRIPTION: Deal damage equal to your missing HP (!D!). NL Exhaust.
shadowpriest:Catharsis.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Deal damage equal to your missing HP (!D!). NL Exhaust.

shadowpriest:SearingNightmare.NAME: Searing Nightmare
shadowpriest:SearingNightmare.DESCRIPTION: X times: deal !D! damage to ALL enemies, then apply !M! shadowpriest:Madness to ALL enemies.
shadowpriest:SearingNightmare.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: X+1 times: deal !D! damage to ALL enemies, then apply !M! shadowpriest:Madness to ALL enemies.
